description_en: Checks the activation status of the Prometheus service or product
description_zh: 检查Prometheus服务或商品开通状态
kebab_example: aliyun cms get-cms-service --product prometheus --service prometheus --api-version 2024-03-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCmsService

parameters.help_en: prometheus: the activation status of the Prometheus service (billed based on the amount of reported or written data)
parameters.help_zh: prometheus：prometheuse服务（按上报量或写入量计费）开通状态
parameters.name: product

parameters.help_en:
prometheus: indicates whether the Prometheus product billed based on the amount of reported data is activated.
prometheusgb: indicates whether the Prometheus product billed based on the amount of written data is activated
parameters.help_zh:
prometheus：prometheus上报量计费商品是否开通。
prometheusgb：prometheus写入量计费商品是否开通
parameters.name: service

enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the service or product is activated

errorCode.description_en:
PROM_NOT_OPEN: Prometheus is not activated.
SLS_NOT_OPEN: Simple Log Service, which Prometheus depends on, is not activated.
CMS_SLR_NOT_EXIST: The CloudMonitor service-linked role is not created.
SLS_SLR_NOT_EXIST: The Simple Log Service service-linked role is not created
errorCode.description_zh:
PROM_NOT_OPEN：prometheus未开通。
SLS_NOT_OPEN：prometheus依赖的sls未开通。
CMS_SLR_NOT_EXIST：cloudmonitor SLR未创建。
SLS_SLR_NOT_EXIST：SLS SLR未创建
